title: Large debug formatting in production paths
summary: Using debug formatting or broad tracing of large structures in hot paths.
rationale: Formatting large values can allocate heavily and produce expensive telemetry even when the business logic is simple.

detection.notes: Detect format!, dbg!, tracing fields, or debug logs involving large collections or payloads.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use structured, sampled, bounded logs and avoid full payload formatting in routine paths.
remediation.tradeoffs: Diagnostics still matter; preserve targeted details for failure investigation.
